newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet passes draft CTZ measures on tax.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet passes draft CTZ measures on tax.

text.p: The Italian cabinet approved a draft law extending to zero coupon certificates (CTZs) a process to speed up reimbursement to non-resident investors of a withholding tax on government bonds.
A statement from the Prime Minister's office said the draft law, approved at a cabinet meeting earlier on Friday, establishes the way in which the faster procedure will work when applied to Ctzs.
Treasury sources said the draft law formed part of an overall process of abolishing a 12.5 percent withholding tax from January 1, 1997 for non-residents.
The legislation defines the process for fasttrack reimbursement of interest up to December 31 this year.
